This '''ship graveyard''' was a massive [[Starship/Legends|starship]] dumping ground located on the edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
The graveyard consisted of a conglomoration of starships and parts that had been dumped in space, from [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT gunships]] to [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and other craft. Scavengers and [[Junker/Legends|Junkers]] scoured the site for usable parts and valuable scrap metal. From orbit, the graveyard looked like a hollowed-out planet.

At some point, the damaged [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Reverie]]'', was dumped by its owners on this artificial planetoid. Several fortune seekers attempted to find and infiltrate the vessel, looking for the valuable [[Arachedron sculpture]], including [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and the two brothers [[Edo Strom|Edo]] and [[Rolu Strom]]. The group fended off swarms of [[Arachedron]]s that guarded the relic and then faced destruction as the ship collapsed around them due to local junkers tearing it apart. The Strom brothers were seemingly killed, while Fett cut his losses and left the graveyard, leaving the ''Reverie'' and the lost sculpture to be ground into recycled metal by the local scavengers.
